qwen3.title: Domain Gear Holdout and Sign Calibration Audit
qwen3.boundary: This phase validates Phase 858 top domain gears on held-out objects and compares best mode, alternate mode, and same-layer controls. It is sign calibration and holdout audit, not final closure.
